# cato_app_connectors (Data Source)

Retrieves ZTNA app connectors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
## Providers ###
provider "cato" {
  baseurl    = "https://api.catonetworks.com/api/v1/graphql2"
  token      = var.cato_token
  account_id = var.account_id
}

### Data Source Usage ###

# Example: Read all ZTNA app connectors
data "cato_app_connectors" "all" {}

# Example: Read app connectors by name
data "cato_app_connectors" "by_name" {
  name_filter = ["kvm-connector-01"]
}

# Example: Read app connectors by connector group
data "cato_app_connectors" "by_group" {
  group_filter = ["getsase-apps"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_filter` (List of String) List of app connector group names to filter
- `name_filter` (List of String) List of app connector names to filter

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of app connectors (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description
- `group_name` (String) App connector group name
- `id` (String) ID
- `is_registered` (Boolean) Whether the connector is registered
- `name` (String) Name
- `private_app_count` (Number) Number of private applications served by the connector
- `serial_number` (String) Socket serial number
- `socket_id` (String) Socket ID
- `type` (String) Connector type
